correctness.rationale: On L² of [-σ,σ], exact Fourier expansion gives Gram=(1+r²)I+r(S_{2η}+S_{2η}*). The residue-class direct integral contains only path lengths floor(σ/η) and ceil(σ/η); their sine eigenbasis gives the complete finite pure-point/essential spectrum with infinite multiplicities, positive lower bound and attained endpoints. Exact rational and floating point finite diagnostics passed 40704 checks; infinite claims follow the independent written algebraic proof, not the diagnostic.
